research_result.description: ClickUp is a productivity and project management platform providing a Public REST API and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI assistants.
research_result.credential_requirements: Users can generate a Personal API Token directly in ClickUp account settings under Apps. To create OAuth apps and retrieve client_id and client_secret, Workspace owner or admin privileges are required.

evidence.claim: ClickUp supports Personal API Tokens for authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: For personal use, authenticate with your personal API token.

evidence.claim: Personal tokens are generated in account settings, while OAuth apps require owner or admin permissions.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Only Workspace owners or admins can create OAuth apps.

evidence.claim: ClickUp's public API is available across all plans, including Free Forever.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Our Public API is available on all ClickUp Plans .

evidence.claim: ClickUp provides a public REST API.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Build your own custom integrations and ClickUp apps with our public Application Programming Interface (API).

evidence.claim: ClickUp provides an official MCP Server for AI assistants.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a secure, standardized framework that lets external AI agents interact with ClickUp Workspace data—like tasks, lists, folders, and docs—using natural language.
